slo_title: Explain how programming paradigms are organized hierarchically

mcq.q: Which of the following best describes the top-level division in the programming paradigm hierarchy?
How does functional programming differ from procedural programming in terms of state changes?

options.A: a) Functional programming allows frequent state changes
options.B: b) Procedural programming avoids state changes
options.C: c) Functional programming discourages changing states
options.D: d) Both rely heavily on mutable states

mcq.answer_text: c) Functional programming discourages changing states

mcq.q: Which paradigm is a subset of the Imperative paradigm?
Which of the following is a key feature of the Object-Oriented paradigm compared to the Procedural paradigm?

options.C: c) Encapsulation and reuse through objects

mcq.answer_text: c) Encapsulation and reuse through objects

mcq.q: In a hierarchical view, how would you position the following paradigms: Procedural, Object-Oriented, Logic, and Functional?

options.A: a) All are top-level paradigms with no hierarchy
options.B: b) Object-Oriented and Procedural are under Imperative; Logic and Functional under Declarative
options.C: c) Logic and Object-Oriented fall under Functional
options.D: d) Procedural and Functional are subsets of Declarative

mcq.answer_text: b) Object-Oriented and Procedural are under Imperative; Logic and Functional under Declarative

sq.q: A program frequently uses global variables across modules, causing unintended behavior. How can procedural programming practices resolve this?
answer: Adopting modular design and using local variables within procedures can limit scope, reducing side effects and improving clarity and testability.

sq.q: A billing system needs to process orders and apply discounts efficiently. How does procedural programming assist in such design?
answer: Procedural programming facilitates organizing logic into distinct procedures such as calculateTotal() and applyDiscount() , enabling step-by-step execution, reducing complexity, and enhancing maintainability.

lq.q: Question: A university is developing a lightweight academic record system to be used in rural outreach centers. Due to limited computing resources, the software must be highly efficient, easy to test, and deployable on basic hardware. The project manager suggests implementing the system using a procedural approach, leveraging structured programming and explicit control flow to maintain simplicity.
